svg.title: Conditional stock OPEN allocation and CABAC ring publication
svg.desc: Seven common-allocation segments place H2C before the driver context H08. The final H24 segment is not the CABAC ring. Dedicated allocation has no driver-relative equation. Publication is conditional and provides no live identity or retention certificate.

g.text: Ordinary OPEN: CABAC ring is not the final segment
All field offsets are hexadecimal. Static stock bytes + synthetic A32 execution; not device memory contents.
Common auxiliary allocation; valid distinct outputs, successful translation, no wrap.
Schematic: zero-sized / separately allocated segments are absent. Ring H30 and driver H0C must be positive.
H24 = D + H0C + H40 + H38 — a different segment
Dedicated auxiliary provider: H2C = translated auxiliary base + H14; no driver-relative equation.
Publication: H2C → caller stack +34 → OPEN packet +38 → context D+544
Builder frame is 228 bytes (hex): its stack +25C is caller +34, not caller +2C.
Unchecked translation status, aliasing, allocation failure or wrap can invalidate the address relation.
No claim of active worklist identity, hardware completion, source ownership or reusable reconstruction API.
